verdict.rationale: Crossmint's docs show a single REST API accessed via quickstarts (agent checkouts, cards, stablecoin wallets) and protocol-specific clients like @x402/core and mppx, implying SDK-style tooling, but no evidence names an official multi-language SDK package (e.g., npm/pip installable Crossmint SDK) and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec, undercutting a clean 'official SDK' story. missing for 10: explicit official SDK package names/install instructions, multi-language SDK coverage, and a discoverable OpenAPI/schema reference.
